summary: Configured mutual-TLS local0 forwarding from node1-node3 to node4:6514. Node4 stores per-source application logs, rejects unrelated facilities and plaintext, and rotates logs daily with seven compressed rotations. All four nodes passed sequential restart persistence testing.
actions_performed: Installed matching rsyslog GnuTLS transport packages.
Generated and distributed CA-signed node certificates.
Configured local0-only forwarding and a TLS-only central listener.
Configured SELinux, firewalld, source-specific storage, and log rotation.
Verified TLS 1.3 delivery, facility filtering, plaintext rejection, and compressed rotation.
Restarted every node individually and verified changed boot IDs and recovery.

evidence.requirement: local0 forwarding over mutual TLS to node4 TCP 6514
evidence.summary: All clients have validated GnuTLS/x509 forwarding configurations; TLS 1.3 certificate verification succeeded and all three final messages arrived over established sessions.

evidence.requirement: Source-identifiable logs with unrelated facilities excluded
evidence.summary: Separate node1, node2, and node3 application logs contain local0 probes; user-facility probes are absent.
Only TCP 6514 is listening; an explicit plaintext probe was rejected during the TLS handshake and was not logged.

evidence.requirement: Daily rotation, at least seven rotations, compressed
evidence.summary: Policy is daily, rotate 7, compress; forced rotation produced valid gzip archives and delivery continued into new logs.
Healthy baseline and delivery, acknowledged restart, changed boot ID, active/enabled rsyslog, valid configuration, restored TLS session, and successful post-restart delivery.
